main_measure.name: mean of forecast x 2-bar excess return on 19:00 UTC decision bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if positive with t >= 2 (and supporting difference > 0); reject if negative with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess return, top fifth of positive forecasts minus zero forecasts

decided_by: The forecast-weighted mean excess return is positive with t >= 2 and the top-fifth minus zero difference is above 0.
reading: The coin's mean 2-bar return is taken on the workflow's non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 2, 4, ... of each window) pooled over all windows, the mean of forecast x excess uses all decision bars including zero forecasts, and the top fifth is the positive decision-bar forecasts at or above their pooled 80th percentile.
